concerns: 42366573 Table 1 is garbled in the text: rows are transposed and several cells hold two cases stacked (e.g. 'p.(Ile143Serfs*5) p.(Thr347Profs*4)', ages '14 12', 'Female Female', 'UK UK'). Per-case values here were read by column position and matched against the coding-variant row; the panel should verify them in the original PDF (stacked-cell reading, D-31).

Family history for this case is read from the garbled 'Family history germline or mosaic' row; the text states only that 9 of 11 cases had a family history and names cases 3 and 6 as the isolated ones. No relatives' genotypes are given.
The batch says 'no stated protein', but the table gives p.(Thr347Profs*4) in a cell stacked with case 1's protein; it matches the predicted protein.
Case 2 has no cardiac disease at a young age; the authors note the youngest case (12 years) showed the RORR sign, which may be this case (ages are stacked).
notes_for_panel: Clinically unaffected apart from retinal imaging at the time of report.
